634:t_2:13.en:
$$ロックオン$$
(You have to change. Do it for me, since I couldn't.)

634:t_2:22.en:
$$刹那$$
「I'm sorry... I made you worry. You and everyone else, $$フェルト$$...」

634:t_3:6.en:
$$刹那$$
「I'll activate the $$クアンタムシステム$$.」

634:t_3:9.en:
$$ティエリア$$
「Can you hear me, $$ヒイロ$$!? I'll link your $$ガンダム$$'s $$ゼロシステム$$ to $$ヴェーダ$$!」

634:t_3:11.en:
$$ティエリア$$
「You'll handle the torrent of information from the $$ＥＬＳ#keyword$$.」

634:t_3:12.en:
$$ティエリア$$
「Through $$ヴェーダ$$ and the $$ゼロシステム$$, you can receive information from the $$ＥＬＳ#keyword$$ even without the ability to receive $$脳量子波$$.」

634:t_3:13.en:
$$刹那$$
「Wait, $$ティエリア$$! If $$ヒイロ$$ receives information that destroyed even my brain...!」

634:t_3:16.en:
$$ヒイロ$$
「Don't worry. Unlike you, I'm used to shutting out unwanted noise from around me.」

634:t_3:18.en:
$$ティエリア$$
「Originally, the $$ゼロシステム$$ was meant to be installed in a $$ガンダム$$ for dialogue and linked to $$ヴェーダ$$.」

634:t_3:19.en:
$$ヒイロ$$
「But someone who left $$ソレスタルビーイング$$ installed it in the $$ウイングゼロ$$.」

634:t_3:20.en:
$$ティエリア$$
「To complete $$イオリア$$'s plan, we need to unite the two $$ガンダム$$s that were separated.」

634:t_3:21.en:
$$ティエリア$$
「$$ヒイロ$$... Since you can master the $$ゼロシステム$$, you should be able to fulfill that role with $$刹那$$.」

634:t_3:26.en:
$$ヒイロ$$
「I am activating the $$ゼロシステム$$...!」

634:t_3:28.en:
$$刹那$$
「This is the beginning...! Of dialogue with humanity's survival at stake!」

634:t_3:33.en:
$$ヒイロ$$
「I'll take... the excess information! You... take their feelings...!」

634:t_3:42.en:
$$クラウス$$
「They should be fighting the $$ＥＬＳ#keyword$$ right now...」

634:t_3:45.en:
$$マリナ$$
「He... is trying to reach an understanding.」

634:t_4:5.en:
$$ミレイナ$$
「The $$ＥＬＳ#keyword$$ gathered together and became a flower...」

634:t_4:6.en:
$$ラッセ$$
「And they enveloped the black hole...!?」

634:t_4:7.en:
$$アムロ$$
「That's right. The $$ＥＬＳ#keyword$$ understood us and saved Earth.」

634:t_4:9.en:
$$シモン$$
「Something that beautiful was born. The fighting's over now.」

634:t_4:10.en:
$$ティエリア$$
「At that moment, I too touched the $$ＥＬＳ#keyword$$ consciousness.」

634:t_4:11.en:
$$ティエリア$$
「Their homeworld was dying, and they were searching for a way to survive...」

634:t_4:12.en:
$$バナージ$$
「So rather than each individual having its own will, the entire $$ＥＬＳ#keyword$$ swarm has a single will...」

634:t_4:13.en:
$$シャア$$
「They were connected by $$脳量子波$$, which coordinated the whole.」

634:t_4:14.en:
$$リディ$$
「So when they attacked humans with $$脳量子波$$, they were trying to communicate...」

634:t_4:15.en:
$$カミーユ$$
「They were trying to understand one another by connecting... by becoming one...」

634:t_4:16.en:
$$アムロ$$
「Their symbiosis with the $$バジュラ$$ was probably possible because of their similar biology.」

634:t_4:17.en:
$$スメラギ$$
「And now... they've come to understand humanity.」

634:t_4:18.en:
$$ロックオン$$
「But why did they choose a flower?」

634:t_4:20.en:
$$シン$$
「Yes! It's the flower Princess $$マリナ$$ gave $$刹那$$!」

634:t_4:21.en:
$$アレルヤ$$
「By sharing consciousness with $$刹那$$, the $$ＥＬＳ#keyword$$ gave shape to the image of peace within him.」

634:t_4:22.en:
$$ロラン$$
「But what about $$刹那$$ and $$ヒイロ$$...?」

634:t_4:24.en:
$$ガロード$$
「Look, everyone! At the center of the flower!」

634:t_4:25.en:
$$フェルト$$
「I have confirmed the $$ダブルオークアンタ$$ and $$ウイングゼロ$$! Both units are safe!」

634:t_4:28.en:
$$デュオ$$
「You're one tough guy to kill, $$ヒイロ$$!」

634:t_4:30.en:
$$五飛$$
「Still, he did well to endure the $$ＥＬＳ#keyword$$ will, which could destroy even $$刹那$$'s mind.」

634:t_4:31.en:
$$カトル$$
「So he really was the Heart of Space.」

634:t_4:33.en:
$$カトル$$
「The Heart of Space... It's a phrase used by the leader $$ヒイロ・ユイ#keyword$$, for something people need in order to live in this universe.」

634:t_4:34.en:
$$カトル$$
「There are many interpretations, but I think it means a heart that understands others and accepts them.」

634:t_4:35.en:
$$タケル$$
「If we can do that, there won't be any conflict.」
